key_points: Pfizer lifted 2026 revenue guidance to $62B, signaling stronger top‑line momentum.
Dividend sustainability questioned in multiple pieces, but analysts argue payout likely remains stable.
Trefis notes new business still a small fraction of total, raising questions on long‑term growth.
Expansion of China cancer drug licensing could add incremental revenue.
Overall sentiment leans positive but limited to short‑term price move.
